checkpoint.outcome: Torch-only fixed-distribution reweighting; no household/GE solve or checkpoint download locally
checkpoint.serialized_parity_override_or_topbin_wei: not recorded in compact checkpoint exposure receipt; discrepancy must be resolved before child-unit m exposure calculation

deliverable: 2007 SCF-weighted single/couple household-exit proxy and selected-checkpoint dependent-state exposure
limitations: Cross-sectional married/cohabiting shares are frozen by reference age; no widow/single-state transition.
Partner death risks are assumed independent conditional on age and sex.
Fixed entrant mass and within-age policy/state composition; no birth replacement, fertility reweighting, PAYGO closure, behavior response, or equilibrium re-solve.
Candidate schedule is diagnostic only and not adopted.

The age-only exposure sums out parity n. Joint n,cs state would recover model-coded dependent-child count m subject to serialized top-bin mapping/weights; those are not present in the compact exposure receipt.
Exact biological child ages, minor status, child-specific caregiver links and orphan outcomes are not identified.
SCF age-specific couple shares are applied to dependent-state households; child-household marital composition is not observed in the checkpoint.
Mortality event totals cover nonterminal transitions only. Model terminal exit at age 82 is separate; candidate age-82 cs=1 terminal-cell mass is reported separately.

method.age_mixing: SCF-weighted reference-age x through x+3 bins; couple shares held fixed cross-sectionally across the synthetic cohort
method.child_mix_assumption: SCF all-household age-specific single/couple shares applied to dependent-state households at same age; child-specific partnership not observed in checkpoint
method.dependent_child_state: cs=1 is active dependent stage; separate parity index n controls model child-count-dependent costs/housing; joint state can recover model-coded m conditional on saved top-bin convention/weights; current exposure aggregates n out
method.partnered_household_exit: q_head4*q_partner4 under independent death timing; household persists after first death

household_composition.sample: 4417 unique PEUs x five implicates; SCF X42001/5 per row; married/cohabiting status and reference age/sex; partner age and sex where present
household_composition.title: Federal Reserve, 2007 Survey of Consumer Finances
